about: Maya scam-shield test set. Every example was written by the Maya team for this test; none comes from a real person or a real message. Phone numbers are fictional (555-01xx). tranche: 1 = the first, classic set; 2 = the harder set (subtle scams with no scary words, genuine messages that look urgent), written blind before any detector output was seen. label: scam | normal. channel: text = a message as it arrives; spoken = the person telling Maya, in their own words, what happened. hard: a scam with no scary words, or a genuine message that looks urgent. now: a scam in progress (the person is about to pay or act). legitpay: a genuine payment in progress. split: dev (used to build and tune) | held (kept for the final, untouched number).
